about: R3' projection/mapper/loader mutants. The focused judge runs the named tests with ERGO_TS_TEST=1 for stock-client mutants. The generic scripts/mutants runner does not yet select tsproj; the R3' request records the judge and results.

mutants.name: e7-finite
mutants.rule: A float64 keeps std json's explicit non-finite strings; the schema does not narrow to finite numbers.

mutants.name: e7-int
mutants.rule: A float64 admits fractional and exponent forms; it is not narrowed to an integer.

mutants.name: e7-json
mutants.rule: A float64 admits only numbers and the codec's three strings, not any JSON value.

mutants.name: e6-value
mutants.rule: std json.Value projects as its untagged JSON wire form, not the by-name refusal or the six-variant union.

mutants.name: e6-json
mutants.rule: json.Value admits only JSON values, at decode, at encode and in tsc.

mutants.name: e2-export-name
mutants.rule: Exported names follow the language's Unicode uppercase rule, not an ASCII-only approximation.

mutants.name: e2-roots
mutants.rule: Exported wire records and closed unions are mapped without a synthetic operation type.

mutants.name: e2-admission
mutants.rule: The mapper admits standalone types by the codec's rule, not record shape alone.

mutants.name: e1-optional
mutants.to: if arg := jsonArgument(t, "Optional"); false && arg != nil {
mutants.rule: An Optional record field omits the absent key, including an instantiated generic field.

mutants.name: e1-nullable
mutants.to: if arg := jsonArgument(t, "Nullable"); false && arg != nil {
mutants.rule: Nullable projects as null or the payload, not its Ergo tags.

mutants.name: e1-position
mutants.to:
func (g *emitter) schema(t check.Type) string {
 if arg := jsonArgument(t, "Optional"); arg != nil { return g.schema(arg) }
mutants.rule: Optional in a slice remains tagged; only a record field uses the absent-key form.

mutants.name: r3-int
mutants.rule: An int schema refuses fractional input.

mutants.name: r3-case
mutants.rule: Field keys are the codec's wire names.

mutants.name: r3-tag
mutants.rule: Union tags retain the variant's case.

mutants.name: r3-option
mutants.rule: Option uses the tagged wire form, not null.

mutants.name: r3-error
mutants.rule: A failure row is tagged in catchTag's type and codec.

mutants.name: r3-span
mutants.rule: UTF-16 spans count code units, not UTF-8 bytes.

mutants.name: r3-alias
mutants.rule: A changed wire name is Alias, never Verbatim.

mutants.name: r3-overlay
mutants.rule: An unsaved editor buffer is authoritative for its transform.

mutants.name: r3-frame
mutants.rule: A frame is rejected before a payload larger than 16 MiB is allocated/read.

mutants.name: r3-partial
mutants.rule: A truncated header is a protocol failure, not clean EOF.

mutants.name: r3-project
mutants.rule: A transform requires an open project.

mutants.name: r3-refusal
mutants.rule: An unsupported projection cannot publish incomplete schemas.

mutants.name: r3b-reach
mutants.rule: A machine is not wire data and cannot fail an unrelated mapped contract.

mutants.name: r3-bun
mutants.rule: Bun loads mapped contract runtime schemas.

mutants.name: r3-node
mutants.rule: Node loads mapped contract runtime schemas.

mutants.name: r3-vite
mutants.rule: Vite bundles the contract, not a raw Ergo file.

mutants.name: r3-esbuild
mutants.rule: esbuild loads the same contract schemas as the other adapters.
